_comment: THE GREEDY POLICY TAKES AN AFFORDABLE LETHAL TEAM PUMP (MTG_GREEDY_PUMP_LETHAL, 2026-10-21). Smoke d0 s1001 gi990
T6: Arbor Elf, Accomplished Alchemist, Elvish Harbinger and Ezuri, Renegade Leader can attack (6 power) into 17;
four Forests + Utopia Sprawl pay one Ezuri pump ({2}{G}{G}{G}: the four Elves +3/+3 = 18). The pump is spent at
combat by the converter (ApplyFirebreathing), never a main-phase action, and the greedy's win projection never
credited it -- so the depth-0 runner cast Weather the Storm and spent the two Staffs untapping Arbor Elf,
attacked for 3 and won T8. Depth 0 (the runner IS the greedy policy, the same Solve every playout runs). With
MTG_GREEDY_PUMP_LETHAL=0 there is no T6 win.
